The '''Horthav system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Horthav]].

==Description==
The Horthav system was a largely uninhabited [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|60|Horthav system}}</ref> It was located just 23 [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] away from the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The Horthav system served as one of two main staging areas for [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] heading to the [[Kuat Freight Port]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>

==History==
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during the [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|campaigns]] after [[Zsinj]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sent a large [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] to the Horthav system in preparation for the [[Taking of Kuat]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
